audit.why: Aatrox out-trades a tank in open ground and only struggles against walls — matching 48.09% over 1,308 games, where the losing margin comes from wall stuns rather than a stage flip.
audit.corrected: Kept; the positioning rule was made mechanical.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns were absent from every stage, including the two abilities the whole matchup is played around.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s and Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s; Keeper’s Verdict is 140/120/100s. A 20-second W at rank 1 means the "bait her W" instruction has a real, countable window behind it.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[1], early and mid now carry the 20s, 14s and 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two kit details that change your inputs were missing: what a blocked dash actually does to you, and how her passive shield is obtained.
audit.why: Riot's text for Steadfast Presence: "If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded." So a blocked Umbral Dash does not just fail — it leaves you slowed and unable to dash again. And Iron Ambassador only shields her if she PICKS THE BUCKLER UP, which you can deny by standing on it or forcing her off. Keeper's Verdict is also a channel, not an instant.
audit.corrected: early, mid, spikes[0] and spikes[1] now state the ground-on-block, the buckler pickup, and the channel.

edits.before: Block your E dash with Steadfast Presence (W)
edits.after: Ground your E dash with Steadfast Presence

edits.before: You're ahead Level 1-2 — even though Poppy has strong base stats and her W (Steadfast Presence) passively negates dashes, your base damage and heal out-trade her in short exchanges before your Q pattern is online. Her real danger is E (Heroic Charge): near a wall it's a long stun that sets up a big trade. Farm in the middle of the lane, don't hug the sidewall, and don't hand her a free dash-block on your engage. Keep it open-ground and your raw trading edge keeps you in front.
edits.after: You're ahead level 1-2 — Poppy's Steadfast Presence (W) passively gives resists that grow as she drops low, and its active stops dashes around her, but your base damage and heal out-trade her in short exchanges before your Q pattern. Her real danger is Heroic Charge (E, 14s): near a wall it's a long stun into a big trade. Also deny her Iron Ambassador buckler — she only gets the shield if she picks it up. Fight mid-lane, off the sidewall.

edits.before: From Level 3-6 you out-drain and out-damage her. The key is positioning: fight in open lane so Heroic Charge can't wall-stun you and her W can't casually block your all-in dash. Bait her W active, then E in, chain W (Infernal Chains), and land Q3 sweetspot — drain does the rest against a tank. At 6, Keeper's Verdict can knock you out of your combo, but the heal amp from World Ender wins the sustained fight; keep an E charge to dash back onto her after she ults.
edits.after: From level 3-6 you out-drain and out-damage her. Positioning is the key: fight in open lane so Heroic Charge can't wall-stun you and Steadfast Presence can't eat your dash — and note that a stopped dash also slows AND grounds you, so a blocked E leaves you stuck, not just short. Bait the 20s W active, then E in, chain Infernal Chains, and land Q3 sweetspot. At 6 Keeper's Verdict is a channel; interrupt or sidestep the wind-up rather than eating it.

edits.before: Fight in the open, not against walls — Poppy's W passive can stop your E dash and her E (Heroic Charge) stuns you into terrain. Land Q3 sweetspot and drain her down mid-lane.
edits.after: Fight in the open, not against walls — Steadfast Presence (W, 20s) stops your E dash and grounds you, and Heroic Charge (E) stuns you into terrain. Land Q3 sweetspot mid-lane.

edits.before: Her ult (Keeper's Verdict) can cancel your all-in by knocking you away, but World Ender's heal amp means you win the DPS race once you re-engage; save E to reposition after her ult.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a 140s channel that can knock you out of your all-in, but World Ender's heal amp wins the DPS race once you re-engage; save E to reposition after her ult.

notes: Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only); no grounding claim was made in this slice.
